selection_note: User-selected examples and earlier reported controls; not a representative/random scientific accuracy sample.
methods: Compare selected summary SHP part boundaries, float64 XY bits and all ten DBF numeric fields with analytical GeoParquet.
List the ten longest WGS84 geodesic edges per selected feature. Investigate all edges >= 5000 metres; if none qualify, investigate the longest edge. Selection is independent of alignment.

Select raw vector and water-mask tiles intersecting each chosen edge bbox expanded by 0.02 degrees, including both sides of grid seams. Obtain tile footprints from official headers/index; do not assume a tile origin from filename alone.
Verify each acquired ZIP member CRC against the producer central directory, record SHA-256 and HTTP byte ranges. Whole-archive MD5 is not claimed when only members are acquired.

For each chosen edge, measure nearest raw centerline support at 101 equally spaced interior samples (fractions 0.01..0.99). Report distances, fraction within 90 ground metres and raw component/segment multiplicity. Use a local metric CRS and report it. A source-summary ID is not assumed to match a raw segment ID.

Sample official GRWL water mask values along the same samples and a 90 metre neighborhood; document classification, NoData and missing coverage separately. Land values in this connected-water product are evidence only, not independent optical ground truth.

Report whether a long summary edge is present in raw geometry, absent while the raw river follows a different path, or unresolved. Do not infer the exact producer processing operation without evidence.
Create inspection plots with original summary in a contrasting color, raw centerlines and mask around each reported location. Use standard plotting tools; no invented imagery.
Preserve failed retrievals and diagnostic attempts. No source repair or release overwrite, no GEE, publication or push.
interpretation: 90 metres is a diagnostic proximity threshold (three nominal 30m source pixels), not a published scientific acceptance standard. Raw/mask share provenance and are not independent validation.
